paragraphs.text: Infinity Globes are single-use devices made of etherium that allow planeswalkers to planeswalk with just a minimal amount of concentration.

The Globes were conceived by Tezzeret on Esper , after he and Jace Beleren barely escaped an ambush set up by Nicol Bolas . Later, the Globes enabled Tezzeret and Jace to attack one another in the Blind Eternities .
